"""One scoped offline body build/proof with read-only AWS health envelope."""

FP = "0a17ae91cf810809f9c6b169378667862bfe5fc9305c158d3c198656055fc181"
FREEZE = "/root/.codex/skills/guala-project-truth/scripts/fingerprint-guala-candidate.py"

def aws(*args):
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(
        ["/usr/local/bin/aws", *args, "--region", "us-east-1", "--output", "json", "--no-cli-pager"],
        text=True, timeout=25))


def health():
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    def service():
        s = aws("ecs", "describe-services", "--cluster", "tfe-web-cluster",
                "--services", "dsf-ai-service-lb")["services"][0]
        arns = aws("ecs", "list-tasks", "--cluster", "tfe-web-cluster",
                   "--service-name", "dsf-ai-service-lb")["taskArns"]
        tasks = aws("ecs", "describe-tasks", "--cluster", "tfe-web-cluster",
                    "--tasks", *arns)["tasks"] if arns else []
        return dict(counts=[s[k] for k in ("desiredCount", "runningCount", "pendingCount")],
            taskDefinition=s["taskDefinition"], tasks=[dict(arn=t["taskArn"],
                status=t["lastStatus"], health=t.get("healthStatus"),
                digests=[c.get("imageDigest") for c in t["containers"]]) for t in tasks])
    def alarms():
        return [dict(name=a["AlarmName"], state=a["StateValue"]) for a in
                aws("cloudwatch", "describe-alarms", "--alarm-name-prefix", "guala")["MetricAlarms"]]
    def metric(name):
        r = aws("cloudwatch", "get-metric-statistics", "--namespace", "AWS/ECS",
            "--metric-name", name, "--dimensions", "Name=ClusterName,Value=tfe-web-cluster",
            "Name=ServiceName,Value=dsf-ai-service-lb", "--start-time",
            (now-datetime.timedelta(minutes=10)).isoformat(), "--end-time", now.isoformat(),
            "--period", "60", "--statistics", "Average", "Maximum")
        return sorted(r["Datapoints"], key=lambda x:x["Timestamp"])[-1:]
    def observation():
        with urllib.request.urlopen("https://dsf-ai.com/api/v1/guala/observation", timeout=20) as r:
            d = json.load(r)
        return {k:d.get(k) for k in ("available", "identity", "live_tick", "persisted_tick",
                                     "checkpoint_error", "cleanup_error", "durability_blocked")}
    result = dict(utc=now.isoformat())
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as p:
        jobs = {k:p.submit(f) for k,f in (("service",service),("alarms",alarms),
            ("cpu",lambda:metric("CPUUtilization")),("memory",lambda:metric("MemoryUtilization")),
            ("observation",observation))}
        for k, future in jobs.items():
            try:
                result[k] = future.result()
            except Exception as error:
                result[k] = dict(unavailable=True, error_type=type(error).__name__, error=str(error))
    return result


def require_health(r):
    s, o = r["service"], r["observation"]
    assert s["counts"] == [1,1,0] and len(s["tasks"]) == 1
    t = s["tasks"][0]
    assert t["status"] == "RUNNING" and t["health"] == "HEALTHY"
    assert t["digests"] and all(isinstance(v,str) and v.startswith("sha256:") and len(v)==71 for v in t["digests"])
    assert o["available"] is True and o["durability_blocked"] is False
    assert o["checkpoint_error"] is None and o["cleanup_error"] is None
    assert o["identity"] and isinstance(o["live_tick"],int)


def fingerprint():
    subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B",FREEZE,"verify",str(ROOT),FP],check=True)


AFFINITY = set(sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2])
def bounded():
    os.sched_setaffinity(0,AFFINITY)
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(60,60))
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(1024**3,1024**3))
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(0,0))


def child(code, env, label):
    before = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"-B","-u","-c",code],env=env,
        text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        start_new_session=True,preexec_fn=bounded)
    print("OWNED_CHILD",label,p.pid,flush=True)
    timed_out = False
    try:
        out, err = p.communicate(timeout=90)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timed_out = True
        os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
        out, err = p.communicate(timeout=5)
    survivors = []
    for entry in Path("/proc").iterdir():
        if not entry.name.isdecimal(): continue
        try:
            fields = (entry/"stat").read_text().rsplit(")",1)[1].split()
            if int(fields[2]) == p.pid: survivors.append(int(entry.name))
        except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError,PermissionError): pass
    after = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    r = dict(label=label,owned_pid=p.pid,exit_code=p.returncode,timed_out=timed_out,
        wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started,survivors=survivors,
        cpu_seconds=after.ru_utime+after.ru_stime-before.ru_utime-before.ru_stime,
        stdout_bytes=len(out.encode()),stderr=err)
    print("CHILD_RESULT",json.dumps(r),flush=True)
    assert not survivors
    return r,out

    code=offline+"""import json,os,resource
import mujoco as mj, guala_body_interval as interval
assert mj.__version__==mj.mj_versionString()=="3.3.7+guala.midpoint-step.1"

 print("CHILD_RESOURCES",json.dumps(dict(cpu_seconds=r.ru_utime+r.ru_stime,maxrss_kib=r.ru_maxrss)))
"""

for line in out.splitlines():

if result:
